job.job_title: Python Engineer - Agentic AI LLMs/ RAG architectures
job.job_description:
Python Engineer - Agentic AI - 15 Positions

Experience: 3-8 Years

Employment Type: Contract

Role: Individual Contributor | Client Facing

Key Responsibilities

Develop AI-powered enterprise applications using Python and modern AI frameworks.
Design and implement Agentic AI workflows and intelligent automation solutions.
Build applications using LLMs, RAG architectures, embeddings, and prompt engineering techniques.
Integrate OpenAI, LangChain, LangGraph, and LlamaIndex into enterprise solutions.
Develop REST APIs and microservices to expose AI capabilities.
Deploy AI applications using Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Collaborate with Data Scientists, Product Teams, and Solution Architects to deliver AI-driven solutions.
Participate in CI/CD pipelines, MLOps implementation, testing, and production deployments.

OpenAI APIs
